{{Top|leg}}
'''Prismatic drill crystals''' were integral components of [[Plasma drill/Legends|plasma drills]]. The plasma drills on the [[E-2 Asteroid Miner]] ''[[Marauder Starjacker]]'' were modified to serve as weapons, with the prismatic drill crystals modified to give the makeshift weapons a longer range.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
